name: force
purpose: An arrow in a scene. Its length is mag times the scene scale, so arrows compare. A slider that changes mag changes the arrow.
binds: mag and the items of dir: numbers or state keys

dir.doc: the direction [x, y, z] in the world; [0, 1, 0] is up

mag.doc: the size of the force; a negative mag turns the arrow round

on.doc: the id of the body that the force acts on; the arrow moves with it

at.doc: the point in the frame of the body on (or of the world)

tip.doc: true: the arrow ends at the point, as a push; false: it starts there

tone.doc: the colour; if left out, up, down or side from dir

label.doc: a chip on the arrow, at most 60 characters; {path} takes a state value

show.doc: a state key; the arrow shows when its value is true

step.doc: the arrow shows from this step of the scene
